bio_am: Ծնած է Կարին՝ 1871-ին։ Վանի մէջ Դաշնակցութեան ղեկավար, 1903-ին մատնութեամբ ձերբակալուեցաւ, զոհ գնաց 1915-ին։
bio_en: Hovhannes Serengulian, known as Vardges and earlier as Gisak and Zarmayr, was born in Karin in 1871, studied at the Sanasarian school and became a teacher. In June 1890 he was a leader of the Karin demonstrations, was jailed for a year, and then taught in Constantinople, where he joined the ARF organisation founded in 1892; arrested through betrayal before the Ottoman Bank action, he was imprisoned until 1897. From 1901 he led the reorganisation of the party in Van after Vazgen's murder, planning with Hrayr in 1902, until he was betrayed and arrested on 4 January 1903; a tunnel was dug to free him in 1904, and in 1906 he was moved to the Diyarbekir prison. Freed after 1908, he later fell victim to Talaat's plans in 1915.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Quote #62 ('Boys, get up, we are surrounded') is his, from the 1903 arrest (#148). Membership of the Ottoman parliament is general knowledge - not stated in the portion read.
